name: Custom Shape 4-Layer Acrylic Magnetic Photo Holder
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality acrylic, offering a sleek, durable, and modern decorative display finish.
    - Features a 4-layer acrylic construction formed by 2 separate pieces, with each piece including 2 acrylic layers for a sturdy and dimensional look.
    - Each acrylic layer has a thickness of 3mm, creating a total thickness of 12mm when fully assembled.
    - Built with disc magnets for convenient magnetic attachment and flexible use.
    - Supports a maximum of 3 pairs of magnets, helping the product function as both a photo holder stand and individual magnets.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall size: 5 x 2 in ~ 12.7 x 5.08 cm.
    - Disc magnet size: 5 x 3mm.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses advanced UV printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Piece 1 – Layer 1: No printing
    - Piece 1 – Layer 2: 1-sided printing
    - Piece 2 – Layer 1: No printing
    - Piece 2 – Layer 2: 1-sided printing

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a photo holder stand and a magnetic decorative accessory.
    - Join both pieces together to create a stand for holding photos, cards, or small prints.
    - Detach the pieces and use them individually as magnets on refrigerators, lockers, cabinets, or other magnetic surfaces.
    - Compact and lightweight design makes it easy to place anywhere for display or decoration.
    - Perfect for showcasing memorable photos while adding a personalized decorative touch.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for family members, friends, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for birthdays, anniversaries, holidays, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for photo lovers, home décor enthusiasts, and anyone who enjoys custom keepsakes.
    - A thoughtful gift for Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, memorial keepsakes, and themed decorations.
    - Great for displaying treasured memories creatively and functionally.
    - Adds a warm, personal, and memorable touch to any space 🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x  Custom Shape 4-Layer Acrylic Magnetic Photo Holder

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

 

NOTE:

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.2 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
